observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The word 'Nikon' is visible on the top of the camera body. The lens has 'DX' and 'Nikon' markings. The camera appears dusty and used. A lens cap is on the front of the lens.
Photo 1: Side view of the same camera, showing the mode dial, shutter button, and the lens. The lens barrel has 'DX' and 'Nikon' visible. The camera body has 'Nikon' branding. The lens cap is off.

Photo 2: Front view with lens cap removed, showing the front of the lens and the camera body. The lens cap is placed beside the camera. The camera body has 'Nikon' branding. The lens appears to have some scratches and dust.
All photos show the camera and lens on a floral-patterned fabric surface. No screen, battery, charger, or accessories are visible. No model number is visible on the camera body or lens in any photo.

claims.claim: While the D3200 is a pro-level camera, it's certainly more than accessible by those who are not...
claims.evidence: The seller's text is subjective and does not state a specific claim about the camera's model or performance. No model number is visible in any photo to confirm it is a D3200.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not be a Nikon D3200 as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body showing the model name, typically on the top or bottom of the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Nikon DSLR camera, not as a D3200, which would be worth less.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The lens may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass and barrel showing no cracks, scratches, or fungus, and a photo of the lens being used to focus or zoom.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used lens with potential damage, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The camera may be missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera body showing the model name (e.g., D3200).
Video or photo of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass and barrel.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
